Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone "PAOLO"
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 03 October 2025(Friday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Batangas, Cavite and Quezon(Tayabas, Atimonan, Pagbilao, Lucena, Tiaong, San Antonio, Dolores, Sariaya, Candelaria, Perez, Alabat, Quezon, Calauag, Lopez, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Buenavista, Mulanay, San Narciso, Catanauan, General Luna, Macalelon, Gumaca, Pitogo, Unisan, Plaridel, Agdangan, Padre Burgos, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Jomalig, Patnanungan, San Francisco, San Andres).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac, Metro Manila, Rizal, Pampanga, Nueva Ecija, Bulacan, Laguna and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Lucban, Mauban, Real, Sampaloc) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
